title: Predictive Surprise as Self-Grounding Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2611.12955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series classifiers deployed in risk-sensitive domains must be (1) accurate, (2) interpretable, and (3) able to abstain when evidence is weak. Existing methods do not deliver all 3 at once, and the obstacle is structural, rather than logistical. Meaningful temporal patterns cannot be defined without knowing segment boundaries, yet meaningful boundaries cannot be placed without knowing which patterns to expect. Existing approaches break this circularity by using fixed windows or expert-annotated vocabularies, thereby sacrificing at least one of the 3 properties. We introduce ConceptTime, which closes the loop through a single self-supervised signal. A frozen probabilistic forecaster predicts a distribution over the next observation at every timestep of the sequence. We call the mismatch between its prediction and the realized signal the predictive surprise. This signal both locates segment boundaries and characterizes each resulting

translated_title: 预测性惊奇作为可解释时间序列的自锚定概念瓶颈
translated_abstract: 部署在风险敏感领域的时间序列分类器必须做到：(1) 准确，(2) 可解释，(3) 在证据不足时能够弃权（拒绝预测）。现有方法无法同时满足这三点，且这一障碍是结构性的，而非操作层面的。若不知道分段边界，就无法定义有意义的时间模式；而若不知道期待何种模式，又无法划分有意义的边界。现有方法通过使用固定窗口或专家标注的词汇表来打破这种循环，从而至少牺牲了上述三个属性中的一个。我们提出 ConceptTime，它通过单一的自监督信号闭环解决这一问题。一个冻结的概率预测器在序列的每个时间步预测下一个观测值的分布。我们将其预测与实际信号之间的不匹配称为预测性惊奇。该信号既能定位分段边界，又能刻画由此产生的每个概念……
tldr: ConceptTime 利用冻结概率预测器产生的“预测性惊奇”这一单一自监督信号，同时完成时间序列分段定位与概念表征，打破了边界与模式相互依赖的循环，从而在时间序列分类中同时实现准确性、可解释性和证据不足时的弃权能力。
